editedExercise.name: Mindfulness

instructions.description: Sit or stand in a comfortable position where you can remain relaxed and attentive.
Sit or stand in a comfortable position where you can remain relaxed and attentive.
Gently direct your attention to your immediate surroundings and become aware of what is happening around you.
Notice what you can see, hear, smell, and feel. Take in each sensation without needing to focus on or change it.
Allow yourself to notice even small or subtle details, giving each experience your attention as it naturally arises.
Observe everything without judging, analyzing, or trying to respond. Let each experience come and go without needing to do anything about it.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the duration of the comfortable, controlled practice.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Slowly bring your attention through different parts of your body, noticing sensations such as tension, warmth, pressure, or relaxation without trying to change or judge them.

commentsNotes: There is nothing you need to achieve or change.
If your attention wanders, gently bring it back to the present moment.
Notice both pleasant and unpleasant sensations without labeling them as good or bad.
